defects.description: Description: cross the arms. Both wrists on their native sides: L wrist x=-0.564 (left of body, NO cross), R wrist x=0.420 (right of body, NO cross). Threshold for arms-crossed: ONE wrist crosses body midline (L wrist x>0 OR R wrist x<0). NEITHER crosses — arms are open/extended, not crossed. shoulderFwdL=5 and shoulderFwdR=15 (both positive = BEHIND per CORRECTED convention) — arms extended backward not forward, forearms cannot cross in front.

failing_tests.assertion: L wrist x > 0 OR R wrist x < 0 for arms-crossed
shoulderFwdL and shoulderFwdR both negative (forward) for arms-crossed-in-front

regression_risk: medium — six simultaneous joint changes; risk that wrists don't fully cross midline if shoulder abduction+forward magnitudes interact unexpectedly. Integrator should verify wrists actually cross (one wrist x sign flips).
rationale: Six coordinated changes for arms-crossed-in-front posture. Per CORRECTED sign convention shoulderFwd -=forward. (1) shoulderFwdL 5→-50: significant forward flexion, L arm swings in front of body. (2) shoulderFwdR 15→-50: same for R arm. (3) leftShoulder -30→-15: reduce outward abduction (was ~53deg, arms flung outward); new ~30deg keeps arms closer to body for crossing. (4) rightShoulder -42→-15: same for R. (5) leftElbow 81→110: deeper flexion, L forearm folds across body to opposite side. (6) rightElbow 81→110: same for R — forearms cross each other in front of chest. With both shoulders forward + elbows deeply flexed, L wrist should cross to x>0 and R wrist to x<0. spine=-14 (PR-v3), globalTwist=-35 (turned away), hips=18 preserved.
